SP: Euclidean nearest-neighbor spacing in raw objective units; round to 10 decimals for validity/deduplication; at least 3 points; not relabeled Spread or Manhattan SP
HV: fixed input-derived analysis reference and coordinate scaling; no internal-learning HV mixed
IGD: mean Euclidean distance from same-instance empirical reference to output in fixed normalized coordinates; in-sample pooled empirical reference, not true Pareto front
aggregation: each Q training group 3 tests; group means equally weighted, 3 groups per case. Baseline seeds same group partition. Descriptive run SD conditional on trained tables, not training-replicate uncertainty.
